## Input and environment

Contract id/revision, source snapshot, environment, agent/tool configuration when
known, and whether this was a new build, existing-codebase change, or resumed run.

## What happened

Clarifications, assumptions, amendments, generated artifacts, and unexpected behavior.

## Verification

Acceptance IDs, pass/fail/not-run, procedures, observations, and evidence links.
Distinguish structural lint from actual software behavior. Include limitations.

## Format feedback

What context or requirement was missing? What could be shorter or clearer?
Do not include secrets, private data, or proprietary material you cannot share.
